content: Ooqarse
Hessafe guye GODAY Muse, «Gibxe kawaakko baada, ‹GODAY nena hizgees ga; taas goynnana mala ta asaa yedda;
neni istta yeddontta ixxiko tani ne biitta ubbaa mooriza ooqqars yeddana.
Abbaye shaafan ooqqarsi kumi aadhdhidi ne soo, ne aqiza soo, ne arsa bolla, daannata keeththa giddo gelana; ne asaa bolla kezana; ne coocen ne munuqa gonggetankka gelana.
Ooqqarsati ne bolla, ne asaa bollanne daannata ubbaa bolla kezana› gaada yoota» gides.

Hessafe guye GODAY Muse, «Neni Aaroone, ‹Ne guufeza ekkada, shaafata bolla, zara haaththata bollanne eellida haaththata bolla ne kushe piddisada ooqqarsi Gibxe biitta bolla kezana mala ooththa› gaada yoota» gides.
Histtiin Aarooney Gibxe haaththata bolla ba kushe piddisiin ooqqarsi kezidi Gibxe biitta may7ides.
Gido attiin marotikka bantta biittan Gibxen ooqqarsi kezana mala izaththoka ooththida.
Kawozi Musenne Aaroone xeygisidi, «Hayssa ooqqarsaa taappenne ta asaa bollafe diggana mala GODAA intte woossite; histtiko GODAAS yarshana mala tani asaa yeddana» gides.
Histtiin Musey kawoza, «Kawoo nees too! Ooqqarsi neeppenne ne sooppe dhaydi Abbaye shaafan xalla attana mala tani nees, daannatassinne ne asaas woossana gallas ne yoota» gides.
Histtiin kawozi, «Wonto gido» gides. Museykka, «GODAA nu Xoossa malay oonikka bayndayssa neni erana mala ne gida mala ooththana.
He ooqqarsay neeppe, ne keeththafe, daannatappenne ne asaappe dhayana; istti Abbaye shaafan xalla attana» gides.
Museynne Aarooney kawaa achchafe kezidi kawoza bolla izi ehida ooqqarsata gishshas Musey GODAAKKO waassides.
GODAYKKA Musey oychchida mala ooththides; ooqqarsi soon, kareninne demban dizayssi wuri hayqqides.
Gibxe asay ooqqarsaa shiishshi shiishshidi korides; biittayka xinqqon zeeqqides.
Gido attiin kawozi guuththa peeqa demmida wode ba wozina minththides; GODAY yootida malakka izi Museynne Aarooney yootida yo7oza siyontta ixxides.
Cuuchche
Hessafe guye GODAY Muse, «Neni Aaroones, ‹Ne guufezara, biitta gudulla shoca› ga; izi shocikko Gibxe biitta ubbaan gudullay cuuch gidana» gides.
Histtiin istti hessaththo ooththida; Aarooney ba guufe ekkidi guufezara biitta gudullaa shociin asanne mehe ubbaa bolla cuuchchi
kezides. Gibxe biittan ha gaxappe heni gaxa gakkanaas gudullay wuri cuuch gidides.
Marotikka ba bitan izaththo ooththanaas paacciin isttas dandayetibeenna. Cuuchchay asa bollanne mehe bolla kumides.
Marotikka kawozas, «Hayssi Xoossa oosokko!» gida. Gido attiin kawoza wozinay minnides; GODAY gida malakka izi istti yootizayssa siyontta ixxides.
Boxe
GODAY Muses, «Wontta maaladora dendada, kawozi shaafa bishin izara gaaggada neni iza, ‹GODAY taas goynnana mala ta asaa yedda;
neni ta asaa yeddontta ixxiko, tani ne bolla, daannata bolla, ne asaa bollanne ne keeththata giddo wolqqama boxe yeddana; Gibxe asaa keeththaninne istti diza biitta ubbaan boxey kumana.
Gido attiin tani GODAY ha biittan dizayssa neni erana mala he gallas ta asay diza Geeseme biittan boxey gakkontta mala tani teqqada istta biittaa naagana.
Tani ne asaappe ta asaa dumma shaakkana; hayssan malaata wonto ooththana› gides gaada yoota» gides.
Hessafe guye GODAY gida mala ooththides; kawoza sooninne iza daannata soon daro wolqqama boxey kumides; kumeththa Gibxe biitta ubbaa iissides.
He wode kawozi Musenne Aaroone xeygisidi, «Biite; hayssa ha biittan intte Xoossaas yarshite» gides.

Gido attiin Musey, «Hessi lo7o deenna; nuni GODAA nu Xoossaas shiishshiza yarshoti Gibxe asaas tuna miish gidana; nuni istta tunisiza yarshota istti xeellishin yarshiko, istti nuna shuchchan caddettennee?
Nuni GODAA nu Xoossaas yarshota shiishshanaas izi nuna azazida mala heedzdzu gallassa oge bazzo baanaas koshshees» gides.
Histtiin kawozi, «GODAA intte Xoossaas intte bazzo biidi yarshana mala tani inttena yeddana shin intte haakki boopite; ha7i taas woossite» gides.

Musey, «Tani ne achchafe kezida mala GODAA woossana; ha wolqqama boxey wonto kawozappe, daannatappenne iza asaappe kichchana. Gido attiin GODAAS yarshanaas asaa yeddontta ixxanaas kawoy nuna zaari cimmontta mala qoppo» gides.
Hessafe guye Musey kawoza achchafe kezidi GODAA woossides.
Musey oychchida mala GODAY ooththides; boxey kawozappe, daannatappenne iza asaappe issinokka attontta kichchides.
Gido attiin ha7ikka kawaa wozinay minnida gishshas izi asaa yeddontta ixxides.

footnotes.text: Cuuchche geetettizayssi hara hara birsheththatan saxxiza uu7e geetettides.
